const int N = 1500;
int st[N], tp;
int a[N][N], b[N];

int main() {
	int T;
	scanf("%d", &T);

			scanf("%d", &b[i]);

			for (int j = 0; j < b[i]; ++j) {
				st[++tp] = j;

			for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
				if (!tp) {
                    // 这里是我之前想多了，其实直接全填 0 就行，相当于没写这个循环。

						if (k != b[i] && k != b[j]) {
							a[i][j] = k;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (st[tp] != b[j]) a[i][j] = st[tp--];
				else if (st[tp] == b[j]) {
					if (tp == 1) {
						for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
							if (k != b[i] && k != b[j]) {
								a[i][j] = k;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else {
						a[i][j] = st[tp - 1];
						st[tp - 1] = st[tp];
						tp--;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
			for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) printf("%d ", a[i][j]);
			for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; ++j) printf("%d ", a[j][i]);
			printf("\n");
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

}

typedef long long LL;
const int N = 200010;
vector<LL> a[N];
int n;
LL y, M;

LL calc(LL s) {
    __int128_t cur = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cur = 0;
        for (int j : a[i]) {
            if (j >= s) return -1;
            cur = cur * s + j;
            if (cur >= 1000000010) {
                cur = 1000000010;
                break;
            }
        }
        s = cur;
    }
    return s;
}

LL checkl(LL s) {
    __int128_t cur = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cur = 0;
        for (int j : a[i]) {
            if (j >= s) return false;
            cur = cur * s + j;
            if (cur >= 1000000010) {
                cur = 1000000010;
                break;
            }
        }
        s = cur;
    }
    return s >= y;
}

LL checkr(LL s) {
    __int128_t cur = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cur = 0;
        for (int j : a[i]) {
            if (j >= s) return true;
            cur = cur * s + j;
            if (cur >= 1000000010) {
                cur = 1000000010;
                break;
            }
        }
        s = cur;
    }
    return s <= y;
}

int main() {
    int T;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    while (T--) {
        scanf("%d%lld%lld", &n, &y, &M);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {

        while (l < r) {
            LL mid = l + r >> 1;
            if (checkl(mid)) r = mid;
            else l = mid + 1;
        }

        if (rr == -1 || rr != y) {

            else r = mid - 1;

}

void dfs(int x) {
    cnt[x] = 1;
    for (int i = head[x]; i; i = ne[i]) {

        if (y == fa[x]) continue;
        fa[y] = x;
        dep[y] = dep[x] + 1;
        dfs(y);
        cnt[x] += cnt[y];
        if (cnt[y] > cnt[son[x]]) son[x] = y;

void dfs(int x, int tp) {
    dfn[x] = ++t;
    rnk[t] = x;
    top[x] = tp;
    if (son[x]) dfs(son[x], tp);
    for (int i = head[x]; i; i = ne[i]) {

        if (y == son[x] || y == fa[x]) continue;
        dfs(y, y);
    }

void pushup(int u) {
    tr[u] = tr[u << 1] + tr[u << 1 | 1];
}

void build(int u, int l, int r) {
    if (l == r) {
		tr[u] = a[rnk[l]] > 1 ? a[rnk[l]] : 0;
	}
    else {
        int mid = l + r >> 1;
        build(u << 1, l, mid), build(u << 1 | 1, mid + 1, r);
        pushup(u);
    }
}

void modify(int u, int l, int r, int p, int v) {
    if (l == r) tr[u] = v;
    else {
        int mid = l + r >> 1;
        if (p <= mid) modify(u << 1, l, mid, p, v);
        else modify(u << 1 | 1, mid + 1, r, p, v);
        pushup(u);
    }
}

LL query(int u, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
    if (ql <= l && r <= qr) return tr[u];
    else {
        int mid = l + r >> 1;
        LL res = 0;
        if (ql <= mid) res += query(u << 1, l, mid, ql, qr);
        if (qr > mid) res += query(u << 1 | 1, mid + 1, r, ql, qr);
        return res;
    }
}
